units.source_text: 是晚藤壶妃子值宿宫中。

en.t: That evening, Lady Fujitsubo was on night duty in the palace.

units.source_text: 皇上对她说：“看了今天试演中的《青海波》，可叹观止了。

en.t: The Emperor said to her, "After watching today's rehearsal of 'Seigaiha,' I could only marvel at its perfection.
What did you think of it?"

units.source_text: 藤壶妃子隐痛在心，不能畅所欲言，只回答了一句“真好极了”。

en.t: Lady Fujitsubo carried a hidden pain in her heart and could not speak freely, so she only answered, "It was truly wonderful."

units.source_text: 皇上又说：“那个对手也舞得不差呢。

en.t: The Emperor went on, "His partner danced quite well too.

units.source_text: 讲到舞蹈的姿态与手法，良家子弟毕竟与众不同。

en.t: When it comes to the posture and technique of dance, young men of good families really are different from others.

units.source_text: 世间有名的专门舞蹈家，技术果然很熟练，然而总是缺乏优美高雅的风度。

en.t: Famous professional dancers in the world are certainly very skilled, but they always lack a graceful and refined bearing.

units.source_text: 今天的试演如此尽善尽美，将来在红叶荫下正式表演时，只怕再看就没有多大兴趣了。

en.t: Today's rehearsal was so flawless that when they perform it formally later beneath the shade of the autumn leaves, I fear watching it again will not be nearly as interesting.

units.source_text: 这是为了要给你看，所以我如此安排的。”

en.t: I arranged it this way because I wanted to show it to you."
